name: document
title: Document delivery
summary: Brief, research, outline, draft and review a written deliverable; fits presentations, decks, reports, memos and briefings.

stages.name: brief
stages.goal: Agree the audience, purpose, key message, format and length.
stages.skip_when: The request already states audience, purpose and format.

stages.name: research
stages.goal: Gather sourced facts and figures for the message.
stages.exit: Every figure the document will use has a source.
stages.skip_when: The user supplies the content and data.

stages.name: outline
stages.goal: Lay out the storyline: one message per section or slide.
stages.skip_when: A one-page memo with an agreed structure.

stages.name: draft
stages.goal: Write the deliverable in the agreed format.
stages.exit: Every outline item is drafted and its sources cited.

stages.name: review
stages.goal: Check facts, tone and format, then hand over.
stages.exit: Output reflection decides pass or human-review.
